cohort: The study included 10,978 women who gave birth at a major medical center in Israel between 2015 and 2017.
finding: Factors associated with exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge varied across ethno-culturally diverse women in Israel, with breastfeeding intention and early breastfeeding being key factors, alongside marital status and mode of birth for specific groups.
mod_finding: Among Ethiopian-born Jewish women, cesarean delivery was negatively associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
